_comment: §17.805 — intent-match goldens for the model_ab.py 'routing' task. Each golden is an operator message with an unambiguous known-correct intent from command_guide.COMMAND_INTENTS, scored exactly like the live top-level router (command_guide.classify_command → route_command tool-call). Two 'none' cases pin the 'default to none' discipline: an off-topic message and a multi-step BUILD deliverable (which belongs to the planner, not a single command). A good model_router / model_general candidate matches expected_intent on all of them. See scripts/model_ab.py _dispatch_routing / score_routing.

goldens.message: search my jobs for the one about milvus
what does the knowledge base say about zfs tuning
schedule a daily research run on AI safety news
set the coder model to kimi-k2.7-code:cloud
show the execution logs for my last job
how much did that job cost in tokens
what's the weather in Tokyo right now
